vendor/pattern.js      src/models/pattern.js
vendor/pattern-svg.js  src/utils/patternSVG.js
vendor/dom.js          src/utils/dom.js
vendor/color.js        src/utils/color.js
vendor/lock.js         src/controllers/lock/lock.ctrl.js
                       (pointer events; original was touch + mouse)
vendor/quotes.js       src/controllers/summary/summaryFeedback.js
                       + src/l10n/en.yml (the English snark, baked in)

Upstream is webpack + ES modules + SCSS + a Roboto Mono webfont + a
service worker. GifOS inlines <script src> and drops type="module", and
the sandbox has nowhere to fetch a font or a CDN from. boot.js is a
classic-script shell around the same 3×3 lock, the same pegs, and the
same three modes (practice / 10-try challenge / 60s countdown), plus
gifos.db streaks and a live "I set a pattern, you crack it" room.

Nothing is fetched at runtime. The notice COPYING-breaklock.txt is packed
inside the GIF as well as sitting here.
